name: Tsuugakuro
source:
Several girls walk the school road as usual. But it's not all about small talk, they are very interested in ghost stories. And ghost stories start to take more and more time of their lives.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
几个女孩像往常一样走在学校的路上。但这并不全是闲聊，他们对鬼故事很感兴趣。鬼故事开始占据他们生活中越来越多的时间。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
